quasarmc_quasium.options.face_culling.to: Skips drawing the sides of blocks that point away from you. Never hides anything visible. Turn it off to compare FPS.
quasarmc_quasium.options.lod_panorama.to: Distant Horizons draws far terrain into a 360° picture around you that only refreshes as you move, instead of redrawing it every frame. Needs Quasar Horizons.
How far away the panorama takes over from live LOD drawing. Closer = faster, farther = more accurate when moving.
